# ADR-3223: AWS network: Peering without least-privilege routes for VPC 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Full-net routes overexpose peered CIDRs.

## Decision

VPC peerings SHALL NOT use a peering without least-privilege routes for VPC 7 (AWS-network-7).

## Consequences

Routes advertise only is expected to prefixes.
